Application Data.NAME: Fresh Market Grocers
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Fresh Market Grocers operates as a retail grocery store providing a wide range of fresh produce, dairy, meat, and packaged goods to the local community. Our store prioritizes food safety and quality, ensuring compliance with all local and federal health regulations. We conduct regular safety audits and staff training to minimize risks of food spoilage and contamination. Additionally, we offer home delivery services, maintaining a well-managed fleet to mitigate auto accident liabilities. Our commitment to robust security measures helps prevent theft and employee dishonesty, ensuring the integrity of our operations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2022, a refrigeration unit failure led to significant food spoilage, resulting in a loss of $3,000. The claim was settled and closed on 07/01/2022. Additionally, on 11/10/2021, a theft incident occurred where $2,000 worth of inventory was stolen, and the claim is currently open and being investigated.
